name: lattice-drift
description: Isometric white bar lattice drifting over a pinstriped floor (Three.js / Remotion, 4K)

scripts.deliver:v1:1080p: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/LatticeDrift_V1_Reference_4K.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -r 30 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -preset slow -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an out/LatticeDrift_V1_Reference_1080p.mp4
scripts.deliver:v2:1080p: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/LatticeDrift_V2_CraneOrbit_4K.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -r 30 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -preset slow -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an out/LatticeDrift_V2_CraneOrbit_1080p.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render:v1:4k && npm run deliver:v1:1080p && npm run render:v2:4k && npm run deliver:v2:1080p
